title: KENGAN ASHURA Part I
synopsis:
Since the Edo periods of Japan, gladiator arenas exist in certain areas. In these arenas, wealthy business owners and merchants hire gladiators to fight in unarmed combat where winner takes all. Toki Taouma, nicknamed "Ashura", joins these arenas and devastates his opponents. His spectacular ability to crush his enemies catches the attention of the big business owners, including the Nogi Group chairman, Nogi Hideki.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

episodes.title: Kengan
episodes.synopsis: Chairman Nogi suddenly calls low-level employee Yamashita Kazuo into a meeting and gives him an unexpected—and unwanted—new assignment. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Super Human
episodes.synopsis: For his debut Kengan match, Ohma calmly faces Yoshitake Real Estate's Rihito, an arrogant fighter with a superhuman vice-like grip. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Tough Guy
episodes.synopsis: Ohma thinks he's got the upper hand, but Jun Sekibayashi quickly reminds him: pro-wrestlers are great actors, and they love to put on a show. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Reunited
episodes.synopsis: Chairman Nogi refuses to enter Ohma into the Annihilation Tournament, but there's another way for him to qualify -- and he'll need Yamashita's help. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Brawl
episodes.synopsis: Unexpectedly, Ohma is thrown into an all-out brawl. Over 100 fighters are locked in a room, but only five can make it into the tournament finals. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Pulling Strings
episodes.synopsis: While some try to enjoy their time on the luxury liner, others strategize behind the scenes, with one savvy shogi player pulling a surprising move. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Night Before
episodes.synopsis: In a tense backroom meeting with all corporate participants, the tournament brackets are finally decided. Tomorrow, the battle begins. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Battle Begins
episodes.synopsis: The Kengan Annihilation Tournament kicks off with great fanfare. First up, jujitsu master Cosmo Imai goes up against American brawler Adam Dudley. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Justice
episodes.synopsis: Nentendo's Haruo Kohno combines his monstrous size with surprising speed and agility, but riot cop Seishu Akoya's got a secret plan in place. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Sister
episodes.synopsis: In a battle between two storied lineages, Raian of the lethal Kure clan takes on Mokichi Robinson, the scion of the legendary 19th-century Kengan fighter. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Ashura
episodes.synopsis: Ohma goes into his first fight of the tournament with confidence, but he struggles against Ryo Inaba's creepy, unorthodox fighting style. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Father and Son
episodes.synopsis: The tournament continues with plenty of rule-bending and inner dealings in and out of the arena. Ohma chafes under Yamashita's fatherly affection. (Source: Netflix)
